input.explanation: The Loss Run (f001:p1) for claim GA1092764 explicitly prints "2020 - FREIGHTLINER" as the vehicle make for VIN 4V4NC9EH9LN248615, while the Vehicle Schedule (f014:s1) correctly lists that same VIN as a 2020 VOLVO. VIN decoding independently confirms the manufacturer is VOLVO (model year 2020, valid check digit). The make "FREIGHTLINER" in the loss run is a genuine data error in that document — it is really printed there — making this a confirmed conflict between the two source documents.
